title: ever HUSH|Chiffon Empire Waist Sleeveless Pleated Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This chiffon bridesmaid dress is the epitome of graceful elegance. Featuring an empire waist and pleated detailing, it enhances your figure while offering a flowy, comfortable fit. The sleeveless design keeps things fresh and light, making it perfect for warmer weddings or events. A timeless, versatile choice for any bridal party.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch.
